title: Sequencing: distribution route
bodyMd:
A van visits five distribution points, once each, in a single ordered route.

Positions are numbered 1 to 5 in order. The items are Canal, Hill, Lake, Port, Valley.

- Lake must precede Canal.
- Canal must precede Valley.
- Hill and Port must occupy consecutive positions, in either order.
- Lake must not be in position 1.
